entries.cmd: podman network create academy-ct3-net && podman network inspect academy-ct3-net --format 'driver={{.Driver}} dns={{.DNSEnabled}} subnet={{range .Subnets}}{{.Subnet}}{{end}}'
podman network inspect podman --format 'the default network: dns={{.DNSEnabled}}'
podman volume create academy-ct3-data && podman volume inspect academy-ct3-data --format 'driver={{.Driver}} mountpoint={{.Mountpoint}}'
podman run --rm -v academy-ct3-data:/data quay.io/prometheus/busybox:latest sh -c 'mkdir -p /data/kv && echo blue > /data/kv/colour && echo ok > /data/healthz && ls -R /data'

printf 'kv-s3cret' | podman secret create academy-ct3-token - > /dev/null && podman secret ls --filter name=academy-ct3 --format '{{.Name}} driver={{.Driver}}'; podman secret inspect academy-ct3-token --format 'name={{.Spec.Name}} data=[{{.SecretData}}]'

podman run -d --name academy-ct3-leak -e PLAIN_TOKEN=kv-s3cret --secret academy-ct3-token,type=env,target=KV_TOKEN quay.io/prometheus/busybox:latest sleep 60 > /dev/null && podman inspect academy-ct3-leak --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | grep TOKEN; podman exec academy-ct3-leak sh -c 'echo "inside: KV_TOKEN=$KV_TOKEN"'; podman rm -f -t 0 academy-ct3-leak > /dev/null

podman run -d --name academy-ct3-api --network academy-ct3-net -v academy-ct3-data:/data --secret academy-ct3-token,type=env,target=KV_TOKEN --health-cmd 'wget -qO /dev/null http://localhost:8080/healthz' --health-interval disable quay.io/prometheus/busybox:latest sh -c 'trap "exit 0" TERM; sleep 5; echo "/kv:app:$KV_TOKEN" > /tmp/httpd.conf; httpd -f -p 8080 -h /data -c /tmp/httpd.conf & wait'; podman inspect academy-ct3-api --format 'state={{.State.Status}} health={{.State.Health.Status}}'

podman run --rm --network academy-ct3-net --secret academy-ct3-token quay.io/prometheus/busybox:latest sh -c 'wget -qO- "http://app:$(cat /run/secrets/academy-ct3-token)@academy-ct3-api:8080/kv/colour"'
entries.stderr: wget: can't connect to remote host (10.89.1.2): Connection refused
entries.combined: wget: can't connect to remote host (10.89.1.2): Connection refused

entries.cmd: until podman healthcheck run academy-ct3-api > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done; podman inspect academy-ct3-api --format 'state={{.State.Status}} health={{.State.Health.Status}}'; podman run --rm --network academy-ct3-net --secret academy-ct3-token quay.io/prometheus/busybox:latest sh -c 'wget -qO- "http://app:$(cat /run/secrets/academy-ct3-token)@academy-ct3-api:8080/kv/colour"'

podman rm -f -t 3 academy-ct3-api > /dev/null && podman volume ls --filter name=academy-ct3 --format '{{.Name}}' && podman run --rm -v academy-ct3-data:/data:ro quay.io/prometheus/busybox:latest cat /data/kv/colour

podman rm -f -t 0 academy-ct3-api > /dev/null 2>&1; podman volume rm academy-ct3-data > /dev/null && podman secret rm academy-ct3-token > /dev/null && podman network rm academy-ct3-net > /dev/null && echo cleaned up
